annotations.title: List the key public bodies of a country

description: List the key public bodies a company deals with in a country, each with its official website, a one-line role and the official page it was read on. Use it to find which body handles a formality. Algeria (DZ, the default country): the trade register (CNRC), the investment promotion agency (AAPI), the tax administration (DGI), social security (CNAS for employees, CASNOS for the self-employed), customs, the statistics office (ONS), the Bank of Algeria and the auto-entrepreneur agency (ANAE). Tunisia (TN): the business register, the investment authority, the industry agency, the tax administration, social security, customs, the statistics institute and the central bank. Morocco (MA): the regional investment centres (CRI), the company register office (OMPIC), the tax administration, social security, customs, the statistics office (HCP) and the central bank. The list is short and takes no filter. Tunisia and Morocco need an API key.

country.description: Country of the data, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any letter case: DZ for Algeria, the default, TN for Tunisia or MA for Morocco. Only live countries answer: list_countries shows them and their datasets. Any other country, or a dataset the country does not have (for example the activity nomenclature for Morocco), returns country_not_available. Without an API key only DZ answers: TN and MA return key_required.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).
